proof_body:
by
  intro A B C
  have hsinarea : ∀ A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))).toReal =
      1 / 2 * dist A B * dist A C * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) := by
    intro A B C
    let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 ≤ 1}
    have hSm : MeasurableSet S := by
      apply IsClosed.measurableSet
      exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        ((isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_snd).inter
          (isClosed_le (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd) continuous_const))
    have hSv : MeasureTheory.volume S = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_apply hSm]
      have hslice : ∀ x : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' S) =
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (1 - x)) x := by
        intro x
        by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
          have : Prod.mk x ⁻¹' S = Set.Icc 0 (1 - x) := by
            ext y
            simp only [S, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨_, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨h2, by linarith⟩
            · rintro ⟨h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨hx.1, h2, by linarith⟩
          rw [this, Real.volume_Icc, sub_zero]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
          have : Prod.mk x ⁻¹' S = ∅ := by
            ext y
            simp only [S, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
            rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
            exact hx ⟨h1, by linarith⟩
          rw [this, MeasureTheory.measure_empty]
      simp_rw [hslice]
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
      · congr 1
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
          intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (continuous_id'.intervalIntegrable _ _), integral_id]
        norm_num
      · exact (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).integrableOn_Icc
      · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with x hx
        simpa using hx.2
    let T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) := {x | 0 ≤ x 0 ∧ 0 ≤ x 1 ∧ x 0 + x 1 ≤ 1}
    have hTv : MeasureTheory.volume T = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) := by
      have mp := (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).comp (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 2))
      have := mp.measure_preimage hSm.nullMeasurableSet
      rw [hSv] at this
      exact this
    have hTc : Convex ℝ T := by
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      simp only [T, Set.mem_setOf_eq, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hx hy ⊢
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨h4, h5, h6⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
      nlinarith
    set u := B - A with hu
    set w := C - A with hw
    let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      { toFun := fun x => x 0 • u + x 1 • w
        map_add' := by
          intro x y
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
          abel
        map_smul' := by
          intro c x
          simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, smul_add, RingHom.id_apply] }
    have hL : ∀ x, L x = x 0 • u + x 1 • w := fun _ => rfl
    have hdet : LinearMap.det L = u 0 * w 1 - u 1 * w 0 := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis L, Matrix.det_fin_two]
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, hL]
      ring
    have hhull : convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = (fun y => y + A) '' (L '' T) := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · apply convexHull_min
        · intro p hp
          simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
          rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact ⟨0, ⟨0, by simp [T], by simp⟩, by simp⟩
          · refine ⟨u, ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, by simp [T], by simp [hL]⟩, by simp [hu]⟩
          · refine ⟨w, ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, by simp [T], by simp [hL]⟩, by simp [hw]⟩
        · have := (hTc.linear_image L).translate A
          convert this using 1
          ext y
          simp [add_comm]
      · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        have hc := convex_convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
        have := hc.sum_mem (t := Finset.univ) (w := ![1 - x 0 - x 1, x 0, x 1]) (z := ![A, B, C])
          (by intro i _; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> linarith) (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring)
          (by
            intro i _
            apply subset_convexHull
            fin_cases i <;> simp)
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
        convert this using 1
        simp [hL, hu, hw]
        module
    rw [hhull, Set.image_add_right, MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hTv, hdet, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _),
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by norm_num)]
    have hsin := InnerProductGeometry.sin_angle_mul_norm_mul_norm u w
    have inn : ∀ U W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ U W = U 0 * W 0 + U 1 * W 1 := by
      intro U W
      simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    rw [inn, inn, inn,
      show (u 0 * u 0 + u 1 * u 1) * (w 0 * w 0 + w 1 * w 1) - (u 0 * w 0 + u 1 * w 1) * (u 0 * w 0 + u 1 * w 1) =
        (u 0 * w 1 - u 1 * w 0) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs] at hsin
    rw [← hsin, dist_comm A B, dist_comm A C, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, EuclideanGeometry.angle]
    simp only [vsub_eq_sub]
    ring
  have area : ∀ A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))).toReal =
      Real.sqrt (((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist B C) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist A C) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist A B)) := by
    intro A B C
    rw [hsinarea]
    have hcos := EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_sub_two_mul_dist_mul_dist_mul_cos_angle B A C
    rw [dist_comm B A, dist_comm C A] at hcos
    have hsin := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg _ _ _) (EuclideanGeometry.angle_le_pi _ _ _)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 * dist A B * dist A C * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) := by positivity
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hnn]
    congr 1
    set c := dist A B
    set b := dist A C
    set a := dist B C
    set θ := EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C
    have h1 : Real.sin θ ^ 2 = 1 - Real.cos θ ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h2 : 2 * c * b * Real.cos θ = c * c + b * b - a * a := by linarith
    have : (1 / 2 * c * b * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = (1 / 4) * c ^ 2 * b ^ 2 - (1 / 16) * (2 * c * b * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, h1]; ring
    rw [this, h2]
    ring
  exact area A B C
target_source: ∀ (A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))).toReal = Real.sqrt (((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist B C) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist A C) * ((dist A B + dist A C + dist B C) / 2 - dist A B))
